segments.ja505:1.1: Ko taṃ hiṃsati heṭheti, kiṃ [kinnu (pī. ka.)] dummano socasi appatīto;
segments.ja505:1.3: Kassajja mātāpitaro rudantu, kvajja setu [ko nvejja seti (ka.), ko ajja setu (?)] nihato pathabyā.
segments.ja505:2.1: Tuṭṭhosmi deva tava dassanena, cirassaṃ passāmi taṃ bhūmipāla;
segments.ja505:2.3: Ahiṃsako reṇumanuppavissa, puttena te heṭhayitosmi [pothayitosmi (ka.)] deva.
segments.ja505:3.1: Āyantu dovārikā khaggabandhā [khaggabaddhā (sī. pī.)], kāsāviyā yantu [hantu (ka.)] antepurantaṃ;
segments.ja505:3.3: Hantvāna taṃ somanassaṃ kumāraṃ, chetvāna sīsaṃ varamāharantu.
segments.ja505:5.1: Sa rājaputto paridevayanto, dasaṅguliṃ añjaliṃ paggahetvā;
segments.ja505:5.3: Ahampi icchāmi janinda daṭṭhuṃ, jīvaṃ maṃ netvā [jīvaṃ panetvā (sī. pī.)] paṭidassayetha.
segments.ja505:6.1: Tassa taṃ vacanaṃ sutvā, rañño puttaṃ adassayuṃ;
segments.ja505:7.1: Āgacchuṃ [āgañchuṃ (sī.), āgañchu (pī.)] dovārikā khaggabandhā, kāsāviyā hantu mamaṃ janinda;
segments.ja505:7.3: Akkhāhi me pucchito etamatthaṃ, aparādho ko nidha mamajja atthi.
segments.ja505:8.1: Sāyañca pāto udakaṃ sajāti, aggiṃ sadā pāricaratappamatto;
segments.ja505:8.3: Taṃ tādisaṃ saṃyataṃ brahmacāriṃ, kasmā tuvaṃ brūsi gahappatīti.
segments.ja505:9.1: Tālā ca mūlā ca phalā ca deva, pariggahā vividhā santimassa;
segments.ja505:9.3: Te rakkhati gopayatappamatto,[brāhmaṇo gahapati tena hoti (sī. syā. pī.)] tasmā ahaṃ brūmi gahappatīti [brāhmaṇo gahapati tena hoti (sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.ja505:10.1: Saccaṃ kho etaṃ vadasi kumāra, pariggahā vividhā santimassa;
segments.ja505:10.3: Te rakkhati gopayatappamatto, sa [natthi idaṃ sī. syā. pī. potthakesu] brāhmaṇo gahapati tena hoti.
segments.ja505:11.1: Suṇantu mayhaṃ parisā samāgatā, sanegamā jānapadā ca sabbe;
segments.ja505:11.3: Bālāyaṃ bālassa vaco nisamma, ahetunā ghātayate maṃ [ghātayate (sī. pī.)] janindo.
segments.ja505:12.1: Daḷhasmi mūle visaṭe virūḷhe, dunnikkayo veḷu pasākhajāto;
segments.ja505:12.3: Vandāmi pādāni tava [tavaṃ (sī. pī.)] janinda, anujāna maṃ pabbajissāmi deva.
segments.ja505:13.1: Bhuñjassu bhoge vipule kumāra, sabbañca te issariyaṃ dadāmi;
segments.ja505:13.3: Ajjeva tvaṃ kurūnaṃ hohi rājā, mā pabbajī pabbajjā hi dukkhā.
segments.ja505:14.1: Kinnūdha deva tavamatthi bhogā, pubbevahaṃ [pubbe cahaṃ (ka.)] devaloke ramissaṃ;
segments.ja505:14.3: Rūpehi saddehi atho rasehi, gandhehi phassehi manoramehi.
segments.ja505:15.1: Bhuttā ca me [bhuttā (sī. pī.)] bhogā tidivasmiṃ deva, parivāritā [paricāritā (ka.)] accharānaṃ gaṇena [accharāsaṃgaṇena (syā. pī. ka.)];
segments.ja505:15.3: Tuvañca [tavañca (sī. pī.)] bālaṃ paraneyyaṃ viditvā, na tādise rājakule vaseyyaṃ.
segments.ja505:16.1: Sacāhaṃ bālo paraneyyo asmi, ekāparādhaṃ [etāparādhaṃ (ka.)] khama putta mayhaṃ;
segments.ja505:16.3: Punapi ce edisakaṃ bhaveyya, yathāmatiṃ somanassa karohi.
segments.ja505:18.1: Nisamma ca kataṃ kammaṃ, sammāvatthāya cintitaṃ;
segments.ja505:19.1: Alaso gihī kāmabhogī na sādhu, asaññato pabbajito na sādhu;
segments.ja505:19.3: Rājā na sādhu anisammakārī, yo paṇḍito kodhano taṃ na sādhu.
segments.ja505:20.3: Nisammakārino rāja, yaso kitti ca vaḍḍhati.
segments.ja505:21.1: Nisamma daṇḍaṃ paṇayeyya issaro, vegā kataṃ tappati bhūmipāla;
segments.ja505:21.3: Sammāpaṇīdhī ca narassa atthā, anānutappā te bhavanti pacchā.
segments.ja505:22.1: Anānutappāni hi ye karonti, vibhajja kammāyatanāni loke;
segments.ja505:22.3: Viññuppasatthāni sukhudrayāni, bhavanti buddhānumatāni [vaddhānumatāni (sī. pī.)] tāni.
segments.ja505:23.1: Āgacchuṃ dovārikā khaggabandhā, kāsāviyā hantu mamaṃ janinda;
segments.ja505:23.3: Mātuñca [mātucca (pī.)] aṅkasmimahaṃ nisinno, ākaḍḍhito sahasā tehi deva.
segments.ja505:24.1: Kaṭukañhi sambādhaṃ sukicchaṃ [sukiccha (sī. pī.)] patto, madhurampi yaṃ jīvitaṃ laddha rāja;
segments.ja505:25.1: Putto tavāyaṃ taruṇo sudhamme, anukampako somanasso kumāro;
segments.ja505:25.3: Taṃ yācamāno na labhāmi svajja [sajja (sī. pī.)], arahasi naṃ yācitave [yācituye (ka.)] tuvampi.
segments.ja505:26.1: Ramassu bhikkhācariyāya putta, nisamma dhammesu paribbajassu;
segments.ja505:26.3: Sabbesu bhūtesu nidhāya daṇḍaṃ, anindito brahmamupehi ṭhānaṃ.
segments.ja505:27.1: Acchera [acchariya (sī. syā. pī.)] rūpaṃ vata yādisañca, dukkhitaṃ maṃ dukkhāpayase sudhamme;
segments.ja505:27.3: Yācassu puttaṃ iti vuccamānā, bhiyyova ussāhayase kumāraṃ.
segments.ja505:28.1: Ye vippamuttā anavajjabhogino [bhojino (sī. syā. pī.)], parinibbutā lokamimaṃ caranti;
segments.ja505:28.3: Tamariyamaggaṃ paṭipajjamānaṃ, na ussahe vārayituṃ kumāraṃ.
segments.ja505:29.1: Addhā have sevitabbā sapaññā, bahussutā ye bahuṭhānacintino;
segments.ja505:29.3: Yesāyaṃ sutvāna subhāsitāni, appossukkā vītasokā sudhammāti.
